podcast.body: This song is the origin point for the straight edge movement and its philosophy. The track, titled "Straight Edge," laid down the principles of abstaining from alcohol, drugs, and promiscuous sex, which became a significant lifestyle for many. "And that term, straight edge, along with that philosophy, came out of this one song of the same name."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
